audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Vladimir / Vladimir / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill, giving Vladimir levels 1-2 outright and never giving him the late game.
audit.why: The mirror audit (mordekaiser__vladimir) already set this chart to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Vladimir. Mordekaiser owns the levels where Obliterate's single-target bonus and Indestructible are online and where Realm of Death forces a 1v1; Vladimir's ownership is the two-item window, which is where a 52.29% over 677 games comes from. Both directions must state the same rows.
audit.corrected: All five differing rows flipped in phases[N].side and win[N] as one paired atomic group, with the contradicting phases[N].why and whys[N] lines and the ratings brought in line.

audit.why: Spike timings (level 6, first item, two items) are right; Mordekaiser's real early spike is level 2-3 with Obliterate plus Death's Grasp.
audit.corrected: Timings untouched; the level-2/3 reasoning now names the actual abilities.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text invented 'Indignation shield (E... his passive/W)' and wants.foe[1] repeated 'Indignation shield'. No such ability exists.
audit.why: Mordekaiser's shield is Indestructible (W), 12/11/10/9/8s: it banks a portion of damage he deals and takes into a shield he can consume for a heal — which is exactly the Grievous Wounds trigger the missing-interactions file flags. Obliterate (Q) is 8s at rank 1 and deals increased damage when it hits a single enemy, so trading beside minions cuts its damage. Death's Grasp (E) is a 700-range pull on 16s at rank 1 and is what drags Vladimir out of a safe position, since he has no dash and only Sanguine Pool at 28s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into spikes[0].text, phases[2].why, whys[1], whys[2] and wants.foe[1]; anti-heal was already core in report[8].t.

audit.why: Realm of Death at 140s rank 1 against Vladimir's 120s Hemoplague is the decisive cooldown gap.
audit.corrected: Stated the 140s figure in whys[4] and phases[4].why so the level-6 row explains itself.

edits.after: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for that. At 2 his Obliterate hits a lone target hardest, so trade through minions.

edits.after: Full kit online, but Death's Grasp (E) pulls you out of position on a 16s cooldown — hold Pool for the pull, not for poke.

edits.after: Hemoplague + empowered Q reset fights, but Realm of Death is a 140s 1v1 he chooses — he takes it at his health advantage, not yours.

edits.after: Level 2 is his — a single-target Obliterate plus Indestructible eats your poke.

edits.before: Trade around his Q cooldown. Mordekaiser's Obliterate (Q) is his main damage and Indignation shield (E... his passive/W) rewards him for landing spells, so the early levels are skill-based: bait his Q, then step in with E stacks while it's down. Level 2 tips your way — with two abilities you can E-Q poke and pool out before his slow (E) lands to catch you.
edits.after: Trade around his Q cooldown. Obliterate (Q) is his main damage and hits far harder on a single target, and Indestructible (W) turns the damage he deals and takes into a shield he can eat for a heal — so bait the Q, then step in with Tides of Blood while it is on its 8s cooldown. Death's Grasp (E) pulls you back in on 16s, so never trade with your back to him.

edits.before: Stack his Indignation shield by landing Q and E on you in trades
edits.after: Bank Indestructible off your poke, then eat it for the heal
